name: Apollo Save Tool
author: bucanero
long_description:
Apollo Save Tool is an application to manage save-game files on the PlayStation Portable.
This homebrew app allows to download, unlock, patch and resign save-game files directly on your PSP.
changelog:
Added:
- Apollo Patch Engine v2.0.2
- Add Python scripting support
-- Run custom Python scripts on the console (for save-game editing)
-- Add apollo module for Python scripts to interact with Apollo's features
- Add Hex Search option to Hex Editor

name: Blockamok Remix
author: Mode8fx
description: Enhanced port of Blockamok for PSP.
long_description: Fly through a 3D world of never-ending blocks and survive for as long as you can! Includes customization options for gameplay and visuals, along with five music tracks.
changelog:
Changes:
- Added widescreen! (Or whatever your system's fullscreen is.) Overlay options are still present if you'd prefer to play with a square aspect ratio.
- Widescreen may result in slightly worse performance on some systems, but New 3DS is the only one where it's actually noticeable in my experience.
- Added three new background/overlay color options and one new block color option.
-- Also reorganized background/overlay color options.
- Added Spawn Area setting that allows the player to change the size of the block spawn area.
-- A larger area will be more visually appealing but have worse performance on weak devices. Conversely, a smaller area will look more cramped but improve framerate.
- Adjusted HUD element positions.
- Assorted minor polish.

Bug Fixes:
- High score is no longer saved if debug mode is used during a game. No cheating!

name: Trogdor: Reburninated
author: Mode8fx
description: Recreation of the Flash game Trogdor.
long_description:
An enhanced recreation of the Homestar Runner Flash game Trogdor, expanded with new features.
- New Options menu to customize your game
- Level select
- New cheats
- Optional soundtrack from Stinkoman 20X6, another Homestar Runner game
- Multiple screen scaling options
- Bugs from the original game have been fixed
changelog:
Changes:
- Music now plays at a lower volume during late level transitions.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed Level Beaten animation being wobbly.
- Improved Level Beaten animation on low-res displays.

name: SuDokuL
author: Mode8fx
long_description:
A multiplatform Sudoku game made in C++ using SDL.
Features:
- Sudoku puzzle generator
- Touch screen support
- A scrolling background that lets you change the size, scroll speed and scroll direction
- Those mini-numbers to help you keep track of harder puzzles
- An optional cheat that auto-fills a cell (press X or Y 10 times)
- 7 different MOD format songs
changelog:
Changes:
- Added Mini-Grid State setting. You now have the option to either reset the mini grid to its default state upon closing (original behavior) or retain its state (new default behavior).
- Added Seed Menu cheat on the difficulty selection menu. (hint: Class of 1981)
- Other assorted polish.

name: CMFileManager PSP
author: joel16
long_description: A multi-purpose file manager for the PSP, heavily inspired by the CM file manager design.
changelog:
- Update libarchive to 3.7.9
-- This fixes archive extraction (zip, 7z, rar) not working in the last few releases 4.0.0+
-- Also added support for extracting .tar archives.
- Reintroduce support for the following image formats: .pgm , .ppm , .psd , .tga
- Added support to open and view .TIFF/.TIF files using libtiff 4.7.0

name: PKGi PSP
author: bucanero
long_description:
PKGi PSP is a PlayStation Portable port of pkgi-ps3.
This homebrew app allows to download and install .pkg files directly on your PSP.

name: Top Classic Plaigarized
author: aionmagan & elpichonart & GGuihurt
description: Clone of Top Neon Rush for PSP.
long_description: Avoid obstacles and shrink when you need to (some obstacles can only be avoided by shrinking).

name: Buggy Mess
author: MEGAgameBoy
description: A platformer made for RE:START 2022 PSP game jam.
long_description: Buggy Mess is a short game where your friend wants you to go buy the new game that just came out, you will need to get out of your cave and go buy the game at the store. This game was originally made for the RE:START 2022 PSP Game jam.

name: Something is going wrong!
author: idstudio
long_description:
Something is going wrong, the game of the year!
Start an incredible adventure figuring from where are coming all these bugs, and who's the nasty creature behind this!
Developed under Gen7 Engine, the first visual programming and 3D Engine for PSP.

name: Founder Of Nations
author: Iridescence
description: A creative open-world RPG game for PSP
long_description: Fight, explore, build, and conquer! In Founder of Nations, you have the full experience of being Isekaied into a 2D world. In this world, you have the freedom to do just about anything. Want to grind hordes of mobs? You can do it. Want a peaceful life tending to crops? You can do it. Want to manage a village and expand it into an empire? You can do it. In the open world you can explore to the very farthest lands at the edge of infinity. This is your story, your life, and your adventure.

name: Mine, Robot!
author: beedge19
description: PSP game where you play as a robot with a glitchy mine sensor
long_description: Play as the mine-disarming robot Isaac who is unfortunately equipped with a glitchy scanner. Disarm as many mines as you can without running out of time or lives!

name: Cowboy Coder John
author: Bastiaan
long_description: Jump into the live of cowboy coder John, who's the new hire fixing pesky bugs!

name: Noodle Box!
author: Alex
long_description: This is a Puzzle (almost-)game that plays like a mix between Snake and Tetris.

name: Medieval Tactics
author: psjuan97
description: Isometric turn-based  strategy game for PSP.
long_description:
Medieval Tactics is an Isometric TurnBased Strategy Game. Heavy inspired in the game "Into the breach", but do it in a few days and for the PSP.
The objetive of the game is to avoid the destrucction of the buildings. Yo must use the cursor to move ONLY the soldier and attack the enemy. Each round is generated dynamically.

name: Untitled
author: KorigamiK
long_description:
You can move around in a 2D plane and you can also see you point of view.
The catch is that not all walls are solid, some are glitched and you can walk through them.
Your task is to walk around and go through the glitched walls.
You start off with only one glitched wall, but as you progress you will find more and more glitched walls.

name: Glitch TV
author: Gremlin Software
long_description: You are playing pong on an old TV that constantly glitches and has to be slapped. Be aware!

name: Phase
author: Jormii
long_description: A PSP game made for the Re:Start! 2022 Game Jam.

name: UniPCemu
author: Superfury1
long_description: UniPCemu is a cycle-accurate x86 emulator (previously called x86EMU before the rename, This isn't based on the other cpu-emulator called x86emu (lower case)). It's a 8086(IBM PC) up to Pentium II (Compaq Deskpro 386, Compaq Deskpro 386 with PS/2 mouse (adds PS/2 mouse to the Compaq Deskpro 386 chipset, optional BIOS ROM replacement (loading it instead, or alternatively a i430fx Pentium or i440fx Pentium Pro/Pentium II chipset with PS/2 mouse) and seperate CMOS settings like the other architectures) emulator(with various, configurable hardware), with up to 80386 timings (80486SX and Pentium using 80386 timings or 1 cycle for newer/unknown timings/instructions, both having no floating point unit)).
changelog:
UniPCemu (pre-bugfix update of 20:53):
- Improved ATAPI SRST to detect aborting a command.
- Improved ATAPI DEVICE RESET to properly clear register status bits as documented by ATA/ATAPI-4.
- Fixed ATAPI function call by resetting a drive using a valid method to properly detect the status to determine what to do.
- Improved handling of ATAPI unit attention.
- Improved ATAPI Unit Attention to persist and error out commands except INQUIRY and REQUEST SENSE.
- Updated the common emulator framework to the latest commit.
- Fixed modem checksum compiler warning.
- Updated the Android gradle to the latest version.

Quick post-update bugfix (22:02):
- ATAPI Inquiry: report no Unit Attention until another command is received, since it can report the data requested.

Common emulator framework:
- Added missing copyright notice for the MD5 functionality.
- Added missing copyright notice for the Switch header.
- Added missing copyright notice for the Vita header.
- Fixed a PSP compiler warning on the TCP validation function call.

name: PSPickr
author: joel16
long_description: A simple color picking game originally made by Sean M. Tracey, re-created on PSP with slight changes. The game has two modes, one with a timer and one without. The timer is the green bar (which eventually turns red) at the bottom of the screen. The player has 5 lives and the achievement is to get the highest score possible which is saved on the device. The one thing that makes this different from Sean M. Tracey's game is that it has a deliberate glitch, where if the user does not guess correctly for over 5 seconds the boxes will disappear for a second.

name: PSP Car Dodger
author: HendersonSoftworks
long_description: A simple game where you have to avoid cars.

name: Mario Masochism
author: LiquidProQuo
long_description: An extemely hard mario game inspired by IWBTG.
changelog:
- Added "God Mode Cheat" mode with which we will be indestructible, activated with the following buttons in the pause menu: Left, Right, Left, Right, Up, Down, Up, Down, Triangle.
- Added new level.
- New "Controls" section in the main menu.
- Changed the main menu music.

name: Nazi Zombies Portable: Reboot
author: NZP Reboot Team
description: Recreation of Nazi Zombies from CoD: WaW for PSP.
long_description: A recreation of Nazi Zombies gamemode from Call of Duty: World at War for PSP made in Quake Engine.

name: CrossCraft SurvivalTest
author: Iridescence & MotoLegacy
description: Recreation of Minecraft Java Edition: Classic Survival Test.
long_description: CrossCraft-SurvivalTest is a project that aims to implement Minecraft Java Edition: Classic Survival Test. It is not a clone. CrossCraft does not use any of the source code of the original game, nor do the developers have any knowledge of the source code. CrossCraft does not use the original copyrighted assets. All knowledge is figured out with documentation and observation of in-game mechanics.

name: CrossCraft Classic
author: Iridescence & MotoLegacy
long_description: CrossCraft-Classic is a project that aims to recreate Minecraft Java Edition: Classic without looking at any of the source code of the original application and without using the original copyrighted assets. All knowledge is figured out with an understanding of in-game mechanics and is approximated to be as close as possible to the original.

name: CSPSP
author: kevinbchen
long_description: A topdown 2D recreation of Counter-Strike for PSP.

name: SpaceCobra
author: MisterX
long_description: 2D pixelart platformer action game about Space pirate Cobra (manga/anime - Buichi Terasawa/Osamu Dezaki, 1982).

name: Xash3D
author: Crow_bar
long_description: Xash3D is an open source re-creation of the GoldSrc engine, a modified Quake Engine running Half-Life, Counter Strike and Team Fortress.

name: RetroArch
author: Libretro Team
description: Collection of emulators for various platforms.
long_description:
RetroArch is the official reference frontend for the libretro API.
RetroArch is most popularly known for being a program with which you can play many emulators and games, which have all been customized and tailor-ported to the libretro API.

It is designed to be fast, lightweight, and portable. It tries to be on the cutting edge in terms of technology supported as well as trying to be as backwards compatible as possible.

name: Wagic
author: Wagic Team
description: Magic: The Gathering game for PSP.
long_description: An unofficial Magic: The Gathering card game for PSP.

name: nullDC-PSP
author: xiro & nullDC Team
long_description: An experimental Sega Dreamcast emulator for PSP based on an old version of nullDC, ancestor of reicast.

name: AgarioPSP
author: SJRNoodles
long_description:
Clone of agar.io for PSP.
agar.io is a massively multiplayer online action game created by Brazilian developer Matheus Valadares. Players control one or more circular cells in a map representing a Petri dish. The goal is to gain as much mass as possible by eating agar and cells smaller than the player's cell while avoiding larger ones which can eat the player's cells.

name: DeSmuME PSP
author: xiro & Iridescence & z2442 & Wally
long_description: An experimental Nintendo DS emulator for PSP.

name: Celeste
author: aggresivepixels
description: Port of Celeste Classic for PSP.
long_description: This is a C source port of the original celeste (Celeste classic) for the PICO-8, designed to be portable.

name: Cannonball PSP
author: stacksta
long_description: PSP port of Cannonball, an enhanced Outrun engine by djyt.

name: Chocolate Doom
author: mwpenny
long_description: Chocolate Doom is a sourceport of Doom allowing you to play Doom, Doom 2, Final Doom, Heretic, Sigil, Hexen and Strife.

name: Slender PSP
author: Iridescence & janosharsanyi
long_description: A Slenderman game for PSP made in LUA.

name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Portable
author: QTeam
description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Shadow of Chernobyl clone for PSP.
long_description: An attempt at recreating S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Shadow of Chernobyl with Quake Engine.

name: DaedalusX64
author: DaedalusX64 Team
long_description: DaedalusX64 is a Nintendo 64 emulator whose focus is on speed over accuracy originally made for PSP and later ported to other devices as well.

name: Touhou Mohofu Mod
author: kene & EmiyaBestBoy
long_description: A bullet hell fanmade game inspired from Touhou franchise.

name: OpenBOR
author: SamuraiX
long_description: OpenBOR is the ultimate 2D gaming engine with over 10+ years of active development behind it. With OpenBOR you can build anything from simple button mashers to elaborate projects rivaling the most lavish professional offerings. Download one of the dozens of ready to play game modules available here, or grab the development kit and start up one of your own!

name: PicoDrive
author: Notaz & Robson Alcantara
long_description: Fork of PicoDrive by Notaz, the Sega Megadrive / Genesis emulator for PSP. This version adds Sega 32X support.

name: uo gpSP Kai

long_description: A GBA emulator for PSP originally made by Exophase and improved bt other developers.

name: FBA4PSP
author: OopsWare & Lbicelyne & Reprep
long_description: Port of FinalBurn Alpha, an arcades emulator, for PSP.

name: GNU Robbo PSP
author: bomblik
long_description: GNU Robbo is a free open source reimplementation of game designed by Janusz Pelc and published by LK Avalon in 1989 for the Atari XL/XE computers. A success on the Polish domestic market, it was later ported to other computer platforms and also released in the United States as The Adventures of Robbo.

name: CyanogenPSP
author: joel16
description: Shell for PSP inspired from Cyanogen OS.
long_description: A multifunctional shell for PSP with a Cyanogen OS inspired GUI.

name: Insomnia ProQuake PSP
author: Dark_Duke
long_description: Enhanced ProQuake, a popular source port of Quake, for PSP.

name: BlockOut II PSP
author: bomblik
long_description:
BlockOut II is an addictive action puzzle game by Jean-Luc PONS.
BlockOut II is reimplementation of original 1989 puzzle video game, developed in Poland by Aleksander Ustaszewski and Miroslaw Zablocki and published by California Dreams for multiple platforms. Original BlockOut was the first video game which transfered tetris from 2D into 3D.

name: TempGBA4PSP
author: phoe-nix
long_description: GBA emulator for PSP based on TempGBA, popular fork of gpSP.

name: Ikezawa
author: weetabix
description: Port of Katawa Shoujo for PSP.
long_description: A port of Katawa Shoujo, a popular visual novel, for PSP.

name: Pokemini
author: JustBurn
long_description: A portable emulator for Pokémon-Mini.

name: Bookr
author: Nguyen Chi Tam & gtzampanakis
long_description: Document reader for PSP

name: Sqrxz 4
author: Retroguru Team
long_description: The fourth part of the (now) quadrology Jump’n Think series Sqrxz brings you onto an cold icy island. Shiny marbles, evil penguins and ghosts, underwater creatures and many more to expect. Original Sqrxz made by Marcus Vesterlund and John Holmvall.

author: MrJPGame
long_description: A clone of 2048 for PSP made in Lua.

name: Sqrxz 2
author: Retroguru Team
long_description:
Sqrxz 2 is a Jump’n’Run which requires a sharp mind and fast reflexes, high frustration is guaranteed. Original Sqrxz made by Marcus Vesterlund (Maze) and John Holmvall (Hojo).
Sqrxz 2 is a sequel to this game created by Rodolphe Boixel (Thor), Shahzad Sahaib (Kojote), Alexander Wiklund, Simon Butler and Jane Mumford (Jayne).

name: rpg2kpp
author: seerouxdark
description: Runner for RPG Maker 2000 made games.
long_description: Homebrew that allows to run games made with RPG Maker 2000 on PSP.

name: Flappy Bird
author: Sandroron & Gears
description: Clone of Flappy Bird for PSP.
long_description: Clone of Flappy Bird, a popular phone game, for PSP.

name: PSP Legacy
author: kgsws & Sunray & Duke & Six_Shoota
description: Enhanced Doom Legacy port for PSP.
long_description: A Doom sourceport based on Doom Legacy with several enhancements.

name: Ubuntu 12 PSP
author: joel16
long_description: A multifunctional shell for PSP with Ubuntu 12 like GUI.

name: JFShadowWarrior
author: Crow_bar
description: Port of Shadow Warrior Classic for PSP.
long_description:
JFShadowWarrior is a port of jfsw (JonoF's Shadow Warrior), a popular multiplatform source port of Shadow Warrior.
It supports both shareware and full game data files and since Shadow Warrior Classic became freeware starting from 2013 with the release of Shadow Warrior Classic Redux, this release will feature the full game for free.

name: TJAPlayer
author: mikr96ryuota
description: Taiko no Tatsujin clone for PSP.
long_description: Fan-made version of Taiko no Tatsujin. To play the game, put .tja files from the original game in the tja/ directory.

name: Duck Hunt PSP
author: FouadtjuhMaster
description: Clone of Duck Hunt for PSP.
long_description: A clone of Duck Hunt, legendary NES game, for PSP.

name: Sqrxz 3
author: Retroguru Team
long_description: Sqrxz 3 is a Jump’n’Run which will please the hardcore gamer amongst you. You need fast fingers and a fast brain. Original Sqrxz made by Marcus Vesterlund and John Holmvall.

name: SyobonPSP
author: DanielBR
long_description: SyobonPSP is a port of Syobon Action (aka NekoMario / CatMario), a frustrating platform game inspired to Super Mario Bros.

name: Quartal
author: Team Unsilenced
long_description: A clone of Portal for PSP made with Quake Engine.

name: Lamecraft
author: Drakon
long_description: LameCraft is more or less a sandbox that allows you to build a 3D world to your liking.

name: PSPMania
author: mafu
long_description: Port of Stepmania, a rythm game inspired by Dance Dance Revolution, for PSP.

name: Neverball SVN
author: GeeckoDev
long_description: Tilt the floor to roll a ball through an obstacle course before time runs out. Neverball is part puzzle game, part action game, and entirely a test of skill.

name: Sonic Robo Blast 2
author: AlamGBC
description: Port of Sonic Robo Blast 2 for PSP.
long_description:
Port of Sonic Robo Blast 2 for PSP.
Sonic Robo Blast 2 is a 3D open-source Sonic the Hedgehog fangame built using a modified version of the Doom Legacy port of Doom. SRB2 is closely inspired by the original Sonic games from the Sega Genesis, and attempts to recreate the design in 3D.

name: Left 4 Quake
author: Ribcaged Entertainment
description: Clone of Left 4 Dead for PSP.
long_description: A clone of Left 4 Dead made with Quake Engine.

name: PMPlayer Advance
author: Cooleyes
long_description: A media player for PSP allowing to play videos in several formats.

name: Frontier 1337
author: Txori
description: Port of Frontier Elite II for PSP.
long_description:
Port of Frontier Elite II for PSP.
Frontier: Elite II is a space trading and combat simulator video game written by David Braben and published by GameTek in October 1993 and released on the Amiga, Atari ST and DOS. It is the first sequel to the seminal game Elite from 1984.

name: LUA Hanging
author: Rinnegatamante
long_description: An hangman game for PSP with customizable words database.

name: Halo Revamped
author: Mexicouger
long_description: A fanmade Halo game for PSP made with Quake Engine.

name: PMF Viewer
author: mowglisanu
long_description: A video player allowing to play videos in PMF format.

name: Silveredge
author: AndrewYY
long_description: Silveredge is a bullet hell shooter for the PSP.

name: PSPBriscola
author: Rinnegatamante
long_description: A PSP implementation of the Briscola card game, popular in Italy.

name: PSP JFDuke3D
author: Crow_bar
long_description:
PSP JFDuke3D is a port of JFDuke3D, a popular multi-platform source port of Duke Nukem 3D.
It supports both shareware and full game data files as well as full game data files of NAM.

name: PSPKVM
author: Slepper & M@x & Anweifeng & Aj Milne
long_description: PSP port of SUN's phoneMEFeature project. It allows to run MIDP/Java ME games and applications.

name: SDLPal
long_description: XianJian QiXia Zhuan (also known as The Legend of Sword and Fairy and "PAL") is an action RPG created by Taiwan's Softstar Entertainment Inc. The game is considered by many as simply one of the best Chinese RPG ever created. Since its first release in 1995 (DOS Version), many new versions and sequels (including a prequel) were created. However, none could replace the breath-taking and tragic tale it was born from. Here, we meet our protagonist Li Xiaoyao; an aspiring martial artist and the lovely Zhao Ling'er, a charismatic Nuwa descendant.?

name: Chicken Invaders
author: Kerey
long_description: A Space Invaders clone for PSP with chickens.

name: Zelda: Return of the Hylian
author: Randall Spychalla
description: Zelda: Return of the Hylian port.
long_description: This is a PSP port of the Zelda fan game: The Legend of Zelda : Return of the Hylian, made by Vincent Jouillat.

name: Quake Arena Arcade
author: Lupus
description: Quake III: Arena demake for PSP.
long_description: A demake of Quake III: Arena running on Quake Engine.

name: Yabause
author: Yabause Team & Andrew Church
long_description: A Sega Saturn emulator for PSP.

name: The World's Hardest Game
author: Chocodino
description: Clone of The World's Hardest Game for PSP.
long_description: A clone of The World's Hardest Game, popular Flash game, for PSP.

name: PSPQuakeIII
author: Crow_bar
description: Port of Quake III: Arena for PSP.
long_description:
Port of Quake III: Arena for PSP.
Quake III Arena is a 1999 multiplayer-focused first-person shooter developed by id Software. The third installment of the Quake series, Arena differs from previous games by excluding a story-based single-player mode and focusing primarily on multiplayer gameplay.

name: PSPQuakeII
author: Crow_bar
description: Port of Quake II for PSP.
long_description:
Port of Quake II for PSP.
Quake II is a 1997 first-person shooter video game developed by id Software and published by Activision. It is the second installment of the Quake series.

name: PSP Filer
author: Mediumgauge
long_description: Advanced filemanager for PSP.

name: PSPlay
author: Amrcidiot
long_description: An homebrew allowing to play a virtual guitar, a virtual bass and virtual drums on PSP.

name: iDaft
author: Matias Najle & Miles
long_description: A sound board that plays phrases from Daft Punk songs.

name: LightMP3
author: Sakya
long_description: A lightweighted audio player for PSP.

name: Kitten Cannon
author: SG57
description: Port of Kitten Cannon for PSP.
long_description:
Kitten Cannon is a super fun distance game! Don't you just love kittens? No? Then this game is the perfect fit for you! Shoot those tiny little critters out of a cannon and watch them fly across the screen. See how far you can fire them and watch them bounce on trampolines. If that doesn't hit that itch, there are also piles of dynamite they can hit to propel them further. Or even missiles suspended in air, just waiting for an unsuspecting kitten to hit them.
Giggle as they bounce from one explosion to the next, spanning hundreds of metres. That is until they end up impaled on rusty spikes or swallowed whole by a carnivorous plant. That's right, they will bounce and meow as they are hurled across the screen. Much fun!

name: Guitar Star
author: festi
description: Clone of Guitar Hero for PSP.
long_description: A clone of Guitar Hero, popular rythm game, for PSP.

name: Wolfenstein 3D
author: Zack & Chilly Willy
long_description: A port of Wolfenstein 3D, popular FPS game made by id Software, for PSP.

name: Free Heroes 2
author: Crow_bar
long_description:
Heroes of Might and Magic II: The Succession Wars is a turn-based strategy video game developed by Jon Van Caneghem through New World Computing and published in 1996 by the 3DO Company. The game is the second installment of the Heroes of Might and Magic series and is typically credited as the breakout game for the series. Heroes II was voted the sixth-best PC game of all time by PC Gamer in May 1997.
An expansion pack, The Price of Loyalty, was released in 1997. Later, 3DO bundled Heroes II and its expansion pack in one box, released as Heroes of Might and Magic II Gold in 1998.

name: JellyCar
author: Drakon
long_description: JellyCar is a great 2d game with soft body physics created by Walaber. This is a reimplemented version for Playstation Portable.

name: PSP-FTPD
author: PSPKrazy & Raf & ZX-81

name: PSPSeq
author: Ethan Bordeaux
long_description: A music sequencer for PSP allowing to create music on the go.

name: Kurok

description: Turok inspired FPS game for PSP.
long_description: A Turok inspired FPS game for PSP running on a modified Quake Engine.

name: GambleFTP

long_description: An app allowing to open an FTP server or connect to other FTP server with your PSP.

description: Bulding block puzzle game with realistic physics.
long_description: Stakker PSP is homebrew building block puzzle game for PSP. It showcases Slembcke's chipmunk physics library and is developed in C++.

name: Xadrez

long_description: A 3D chess game for PSP.

long_description: Port of the original Doom for PSP.

long_description:
Super Mario War is a Super Mario multiplayer game.
The goal is to stomp as many other Marios as possible to win the game.

author: SofiyaCat
